source_scope.material: polylactic-acid micro/nanoplastics before and after UV aging
source_scope.design: three normalized abundance columns for A_PLA, three for HP control, and three for PLA
source_scope.biological_unit: pooled_or_unspecified_human_plasma; donor-level independence is not reported in the deposited result workbook
prohibited_interpretations: The nine instrument columns are not nine independent donor cohorts.
HP is a plasma control and is not a nanoparticle-corona measurement batch.
The six corona batches do not satisfy the frozen R4 minimum of twelve external batches and cannot be promoted to the primary OOD endpoint.
This source is not an independent evaluator receipt, lockbox, no-author-team reproduction or material-design result.

quantification_contract.source_accession_policy: map only an exact non-empty Accession value present in the frozen R3 sequence-feature table
quantification_contract.rank_eligibility: candidate corona condition plus strictly positive finite normalized abundance
quantification_contract.numeric_zero_policy: retain as NUMERIC_ZERO and exclude from rank; never impute
quantification_contract.blank_policy: retain as SOURCE_BLANK and exclude from rank; never impute

claim_boundary: This audit makes a CC0 PXD060795 result workbook byte-verifiable and cell-traceable for a separate R4 small-n sensitivity protocol. It contributes a new laboratory anchor and quantitative compatibility evidence, but its six qualifying corona batches remain below the frozen primary OOD minimum; it does not establish independent validation, lockbox evaluation, external scientific reproduction or scientific submission readiness.
